title: Netflix to lay off nearly 1,000 employees amid stagnating growth, stiff competition
llm_summary: Netflix announced it will cut roughly 1,000 jobs—about 5% of its workforce—after a slowdown in subscriber growth and mounting pressure from rivals such as Disney+, HBO Max, and emerging AI‑driven streaming platforms.
